description: Fork of exp710 (in-flight, exp708's 116.4M scaled to bs=48 16K = 393M tokens) doubling E and d_v: embedding_dim 192 -> 384, d_v 32 -> 64. H*d_v = 384 = E preserved. Expected ~179.32M params (+62.9M vs exp710): v_lut +3.15M/layer, out_proj +6.29M/layer, tok_emb_E +6.29M. Same compute as exp709 (vanilla untied bs=48 16K = 1.1922 @ 35.79M). Tests whether E is a working capacity lever at the 393M-token compute scale and what gap remains to vanilla untied. All other config identical to exp710 (RoPE, bs=48 phys, total_batch=24576, hybrid_smooth, lion lut_lr=2e-4). Comparison anchors: exp710 (TBD), exp709=1.1922 @ 35.79M.
